checkpoints.question: Mat has the tallest bar. What happens most of the time?
options: The model usually picks mat, but sometimes another word.
The model looks the word up.
checkpoints.explain: It samples: the tallest bar wins most often, not every time. That is why the same question can get different answers.

checkpoints.question: Why might the model write Sydney as the capital of Australia?
options: Sydney and capital often appear together in text.
checkpoints.explain: Likely words are not always true words. The capital is Canberra.
